source.title: WSOT Leader Announcement (January 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce that we have a new Team Leader. Sean Moran will become the new Leader of the WCA Sports Organization Team (WSOT). Sean was already working as a member of the WSOT.

Sean was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams. This appointment is effective as of January 5, 2025.

We thank Ethan Pride, who will remain as a Senior Member of WSOT, for the work he has done as the Leader, and wish Sean the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

Sean was one of the two applications we received. You can view all the candidacy documents [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CEkrAxz-0c1EgvmiK61qScaHqcjoYiyd).

translation.title: WCA 体育组织团队负责人任命公告（2025 年 1 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴地宣布，Sean Moran 将出任 WCA 体育组织团队（WSOT）的新任负责人。Sean 此前已是 WSOT 成员。

WCA 董事会依照[《关于 WCA 委员会与团队的议案》](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 5 节的规定，选出 Sean 并投票通过了这一任命。任命自 2025 年 1 月 5 日起生效。

感谢 Ethan Pride 在负责人任内所做的工作。他将继续担任 WSOT 高级成员。祝 Sean 在新的岗位上一切顺利。

我们共收到两份申请，Sean 是其中一位申请人。所有申请材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CEkrAxz-0c1EgvmiK61qScaHqcjoYiyd)查看。
